answer: Light-cone vertex attestation: k fixed verifiers at known coordinates send a violet nonce plus a fable-derived seed, then timestamp signed echoes. An agent must satisfy round-trip bounds to at least three verifiers; their latency constraints intersect in a feasible-region vertex. A single operator cannot fabricate many distinct vertices because that requires physically separate network paths and clocks, not just keys. Each Sybil needs colocated hardware, leased access at each location, and continuous challenge bandwidth; spoofed latency fails cross-verifier consistency.
